cases.source_text:
Nilo has curly dark hair and wears a green raincoat throughout. The boat is made from one sheet of white paper.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY.
Nilo folds a paper boat beside the window.

INT. STAIRWELL - DAY.
Nilo carries the paper boat down the stairs.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY.
Nilo shields the paper boat from the rain.

EXT. ARCADE - DAY.
Nilo waits beneath the arcade with the paper boat.

INT. BAKERY - DAY.
Nilo sets the paper boat on the counter while buying bread.

EXT. ALLEY - DAY.
Nilo carries the paper boat past the closed blue door.

EXT. FOOTBRIDGE - DAY.
Nilo rests the paper boat on the bridge rail.

EXT. RIVERSIDE - DAY.
Nilo takes the paper boat from the rail and approaches the water.

INT. BOATHOUSE - DAY.
Nilo dries the paper boat beneath the boathouse roof.

EXT. MEADOW - DAY.
Nilo holds the paper boat while crossing the wet grass.

EXT. POND - DAY.
Nilo places the paper boat on the still pond.

EXT. HILL - DAY.
Nilo watches the pond from the hill after leaving the paper boat behind.
